title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Targeted response to essential needs of affected communities in Kachin State and Southeast Myanmar programme is implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 3.1: Women and older adolescent girls experience increased safety, psychosocial wellbeing, and meaningful participation and leadership. The activities and objective include Train and accompany partner staff and community volunteers in target areas on core skills for GBV programming, update GBV referral pathways, provide community-focused GBV case management services and rehabilitate women only centres. So, women, older adolescent girls and GBV survivors use specialised interventions and psychosocial support to meet their needs and preferences. Programmes are in partnership with Karuna Mission Social Solidarity-KMSS-Myitkyina Diocese, Swan In Thit and Kachin Women's Union. ---- The principal focus of this objective is:- Women’s protection and access to specialised GBVsupports- Reduce social, economic or political power inequalities between women and men, girls and boys- Support to women’s equality organisations and institutions
